blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) says that Rasulullah ﷺ told him, “(Before setting out on the journey) pray two rak'ahs!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِذَا دَخَلْتَ مَنْزِلَكَ فَصَلِّ رَكَعَتَيْنِ تَمْنَعَانِكَ مَدْخَلَ السُّوءِ، وَإِذَا خَرَجْتَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِكَ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ تَمْنَعَانِكَ مَخْرَجَ السُّوءِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار ورجاله موثقون مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٥٧٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “When you enter your house, pray two rak'ahs. These two rak'ahs will protect you from the harm that comes after you enter the house. Likewise, before leaving the house, pray two rak'ahs. These two rak'ahs will protect you from the harm that comes after you leave the house.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ لَهُ: كَيْفَ تَقْرَأُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ؟ فَقَرَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ أُمَّ الْقُرْآنِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَاأَنْزَلَ اللهُ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ وَلَافِي اْلاِنْجِيلِ وَلاِفِي الزَّبُورِ وَلاِفِي الْقُرْآنِ مِثْلَهَا وَإِنَّهَا لَلسَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي.
blocks.tamil_translation: The Prophet ﷺ asked me, “What do you recite at the beginning of Salah?” I recited Surah al-Fatihah to him. The Prophet ﷺ said, “By the One in whose hand is my life! Allah has not revealed a surah like it in the Tawrah, the Injil, the Zabur, or in the other parts of the Qur'an. This (Surah al-Fatihah) is the seven verses that are recited again and again in every rak'ah of every Salah.” Hazrat Ubayy ibn Ka'b (RA)
